spans.s: 1. द the 3rd and soft letter of the 4th or dental class.

2. द mf(आ)n. (√ 1. दा) ifc. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 3) giving, granting, offering, effecting, producing (e.g. अभीष्ट-, ‘giving any desired object’, Pañcat. ii, 50; गज-वाजि-वृद्धि-, ‘promoting the welfare of elephants and horses’, VarBṛS. xviii, 5), Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. अग्नि-; अ-दोम-द॑; अन्न-, अर्थ-, गर्भ-, जन्म- &c.)
n. a gift, L.
3. द mfn. (√ दो) ifc. See अनल-, 2. जीव-
n. the act of cutting off, L.
4. द mfn. (√ 4. द-) ifc. See ऋश्य-द॑.
